case_number: 2025 INSC 429; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) No. 7851 OF 2023

parties.petitioner: M/S FERRO CONCRETE CONSTRUCTION (INDIA) PVT. LTD.

summary: Contractual bar on interest vs arbitrator's power under Arbitration Act, 1940; standard: clear and express exclusion required; Clause 22 not sufficient to oust pendente lite interest; strict construction of anti-interest clauses; precedent from Reliance Cellulose reaffirmed; High Court's setting aside of interest set aside; arbitrator's award of 15% interest reinstated.
legal_provisions_cited: G.C. Roy v. Secretary, Irrigation Department, (1992) 1 SCC 508
N.C. Budharaj v. Executive Engineer, (2001) 2 SCC 721
Reliance Cellulose Products Ltd v. ONGC
Union of India v. Ambica Construction
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; award of pendente lite interest at 15% per annum reinstated.
